newsitem.title: USA: St. Paul mayor switches from Democrat to Republican.
newsitem.headline: St. Paul mayor switches from Democrat to Republican.

text.p: St. Paul Mayor Norm Coleman switched to the Republican party Wednesday amid speculation that he might run for governor or Congress.
Coleman announced his decision with high-level Republicans looking on, including former Cabinet member and vice presidential candidate Jack Kemp and Minnesota Gov. Arne Carlson.
Some of Coleman's conservative views were at odds with the liberal Democratic-Farmer-Labor party, as the Democratic party is known in Minnesota.

It was expected that Coleman would seek another term as mayor under his new party banner next year. There was also speculation that he might try to succeed Carlson when the governor's term is up in 1998, or perhaps run for Congress.
Carlson has said he does not plan to seek re-election.
